name: Alemayehu Mekonen
role: Senior Full Stack Engineer & AI Product Developer
tagline: From database to interface, I build systems that stay up — and the AI agents that make them smarter.
bio: I'm a software engineer working across backend services, platform infrastructure, and — most recently — applied AI. Most of my work sits where those meet: designing a service, containerising it, making sure it can be deployed and observed without ceremony, and now building the agents and retrieval systems that sit in front of that data.

I currently hold two roles at once. At Safaricom Ethiopia I'm a Senior Backend Engineer on telecom fintech transaction services — microservices behind M-PESA LiteApp and USSD mobile money, where correctness and fault recovery matter more than almost anything else. In parallel, I work remotely for Universal Perk, a Texas-based company, building AI products end to end: Creva AI, Dasguzo, and other SaaS tools, from backend and auth through to the interfaces people actually use.

Before that I ran CI/CD and Kubernetes operations for a bank's core banking applications at Lion International Bank, and built full-stack features at Addis Software. I work mainly in Java and Spring Boot, TypeScript and Node.js, with Docker and Kubernetes for delivery — and I've been building agentic and retrieval-augmented systems long enough that this portfolio's own AI assistant is one of them, not just a description of the skill.

focusAreas.title: Backend engineering
focusAreas.description: Spring Boot and Node.js services, REST APIs, authentication with Keycloak and OAuth2, and message-driven communication with RabbitMQ.

focusAreas.title: Distributed systems
focusAreas.description: Decomposing applications into services with their own configuration, discovery, gateway and logging concerns — and keeping the seams between them explicit.

focusAreas.title: AI systems
focusAreas.description: Retrieval-augmented generation, tool-calling agents, and prompt design — built end to end, not just integrated against an API.

focusAreas.title: Delivery and operations
focusAreas.description: Jenkins and CI/CD pipelines, Docker images, Kubernetes workloads and Linux servers, with Grafana and Prometheus for visibility once it's running.

availability.message: Open to backend, platform and AI engineering roles
